'''K'ar Zah''' was a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Zah was the [[Chief Scientist/Legends|Chief Scientist]] of the [[Imperial Academy of Science and Methodology]].<ref name="SWG:SCoS" /> As of [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> K'ar Zah was working on an article titled ''"[[The Superiority of Sentience: Nature's Deadliest Weapon]]"''. As Zah was in need of further case studies for his work, the scientist searched for courageous individuals to face some of the galaxy's most dangerous predators, armed with simple [[Vibro-weapon/Legends|vibroweapons]] and/or primitive [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrowers]]. According to Zah's theory, in eight out of ten encounters the sentient hunter would emerge victorious.<ref name="SWG:SCoS" />

==Behind the scenes==
K'ar Zah was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SCoS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
